# XML sitemap generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/sitemap-generator/

Convert a list of absolute HTTP or HTTPS page URLs into a properly escaped XML sitemap. Remove duplicates and download the generated document.

## How to use it

1. Enter the page information, rules or URLs you control.
2. Generate the file or markup and review its content.
3. Copy or download it for use on your own website.

## Example

Create a small sitemap from the public pages of a newly launched static website.

## Limits and checks

List URLs you control and want indexed. A sitemap helps discovery but does not guarantee crawling or search visibility.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
